paras: Liolaemus donosobarrosi, commonly known as Donoso-Barros' tree iguana, is a species of lizard in the family  Liolaemidae. The species is endemic to Argentina.
The specific name, donosobarrosi, is in honor of Chilean herpetologist Roberto Donoso-Barros.
L. donosobarrosi is found in central Argentina, in the provinces of Mendoza, Neuquén, and Río Negro.
The preferred natural habitat of L. donosobarrosi is shrubland, at altitudes of 900–1,200 m (3,000–3,900 ft).
